caption: The image is a grayscale photograph of a rectangular plaque, possibly made of stone or cast metal, featuring three main sections. The top section is divided into two arched panels with decorative columns between them; the left panel contains a raised image of a stylized heart with a flame-like element above it, while the right panel depicts a vase with three large flowers or leaves emerging from it. Both arches have a textured, radiating pattern above them. Below these panels, a horizontal rectangular area contains the name “GEORGE STEVENSON” in capital letters, centered and carved in raised relief. The bottom section features a raised, large date reading “1763” inside a partially bordered cartouche-like shape. The plaque has a plain border and appears to be monochromatic in color, consistent with the grayscale presentation, with varying shades of gray indicating depth and texture. The background outside the plaque is a light, solid color, probably the paper or mounting surface.
